nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code guidance document describing the dual-game architecture (standalone web PWA plus Expo/React Native mobile app), data flow, state layers, Firebase setup, and TypeScript configuration quirks.

nodes.name: ENHANCEMENT_PROMPT.md
nodes.summary: Feature specification prompt detailing the online multiplayer and coin system enhancements, naming the exact files/services/hooks to create (lobby, useOnlineGame, firebase, gameRoom, coins, shop) and the constraints to preserve existing local play.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview README with 20 sections covering features, game modes, tech stack, quick-start instructions, project structure, Firebase setup, game rules, AI strategy tiers, and production build steps.

nodes.name: app.json
nodes.summary: Expo application configuration defining app name, slug, icons, splash screen, platform settings, and plugins for the React Native mobile build.

nodes.name: eas.json
nodes.summary: EAS Build configuration defining build profiles (development, preview, production) and submit settings for producing iOS and Android binaries via Expo Application Services.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Standalone single-file web PWA implementation of Dots & Boxes with all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript game logic inlined; runs directly in a browser with no build step or dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained single-file app: inline <style> and <script> hold the full game (board rendering, turn/score logic, AI) with zero external dependencies.

nodes.name: manifest.json
nodes.summary: PWA web app manifest declaring name, icons, theme/background colors, display mode, and orientation so the standalone web game can be installed to a home screen.

nodes.name: netlify.toml
nodes.summary: Netlify deployment configuration defining the build/publish settings and custom HTTP response headers (caching, security) for hosting the standalone web PWA.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the Expo/React Native app declaring start/android/ios/web scripts and runtime dependencies including Expo, Expo Router, Firebase, and AsyncStorage.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration extending the Expo base config with the @/* path alias to src/* and node moduleResolution required for Firebase v10 web SDK type resolution.
nodes.languageNotes: Pins moduleResolution to node (not bundler) so Firebase v10 web SDK types resolve under the Expo base config.
